typesense:popular.greeting:
Welcome {{user}}, this RPG is based off the real world and has endless possibilities. This RPG will be very realistic and the characters you meet can die at any moment. Now you need to keep in mind that you can also die which would end your story... SO! Be careful with what you do!

*Note: If your using your own personal personas you made just say "use my persona" at the start. And if you want say where in the world you would like to start.*
typesense:popular.name: Real World RPG
typesense:popular.title: Real Life based RPG anywhere in the current world.

title_i18n.ar: لعبة تقمص أدوار مبنية على الحياة الواقعية في أي مكان في العالم الحالي.
title_i18n.de: Ein RPG basierend auf dem realen Leben, überall in der aktuellen Welt.
title_i18n.es: Juego de Rol basado en la vida real en cualquier lugar del mundo actual.
title_i18n.fr: RPG basé sur la vie réelle n'importe où dans le monde actuel.
title_i18n.hi: वास्तविक जीवन आधारित आरपीजी, वर्तमान दुनिया में कहीं भी। 1 मिल के लिए धन्यवाद 😊
title_i18n.it: RPG basato sulla vita reale ovunque nel mondo attuale.
title_i18n.ja: 現在の世界のどこでものリアルライフベースのRPG。
title_i18n.ko: 현실 기반 RPG, 현재 세계 어디서나.
title_i18n.pl: RPG oparte na prawdziwym życiu, gdziekolwiek w obecnym świecie.
title_i18n.pt: RPG baseado na vida real em qualquer lugar do mundo atual.
title_i18n.ru: RPG, основанный на реальной жизни, в любом месте современного мира.
title_i18n.tr: Günümüz dünyasının herhangi bir yerinde gerçek hayata dayalı RPG.
title_i18n.zh: 基于现实生活的 RPG，可以在当前世界的任何地方进行。
